name: relative_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional directional orders (FII equity block deals, domestic fund rebalancing) execute over 30-180 minutes via TWAP algorithms that create a gentle session drift. When the 2-minute return rate suddenly exceeds twice the session drift rate, it signals these orders have entered an urgency phase — either a new buyer joined an existing trend or a staggered TWAP order accelerated near its deadline. At 5-second resolution, this acceleration is detectable ~15 seconds before a 1-minute bar confirms it, and the institutional flow typically sustains for another 30-90 seconds as the order continues filling. The session drift rate normalises for time-of-day effects: a 0.3% move at 09:45 (30 min in) is the same drift rate as 1.2% at 13:00 (240 min in), preventing false signals from large opening moves.

indicators.name: session_return
indicators.purpose: Establishes session drift direction and magnitude. Cumulative from day open — no fixed lookback. Mirrors original's stock_return and nifty_return which were both session-cumulative. Acts as the 'baseline' return against which recent momentum is compared.

indicators.name: recent_return_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute return (24 bars × 5s). Original used relative_return_30 with 30-min lookback; compressed to 2 min because at 5s frequency we are trading the acceleration burst, not the multi-hour sustained outperformance. At 30-90s hold times, the signal must be as recent as possible — 2 min is the right window to isolate TWAP urgency phases from background drift.

indicators.name: session_rate
indicators.purpose: Per-bar session drift rate. Normalises session_return by elapsed time so that a 0.3% move in the first 30 min is equivalent drift-rate to 1.2% in the first 120 min. Required to make the relative ratio comparable across different times of day.

indicators.name: recent_rate
indicators.purpose: Per-bar return rate over the last 2 minutes (24 bars). The ratio recent_rate / session_rate > threshold replicates the original's 'stock return > 2x NIFTY return' logic, adapted to a single index comparing its own recent burst vs session baseline.

conditions: recent_rate > rel_ratio_threshold * session_rate (current 2-min acceleration exceeds 2× session drift rate)
recent_return_24 > 0 (last 2 min actually positive, not reverting)
buy_ce.confirmation: Both session drift is positive AND recent burst exceeds the threshold multiple — prevents misfires during flat sessions or reversals

conditions: recent_rate < rel_ratio_threshold * session_rate (current 2-min acceleration exceeds 2× session downward drift rate — both values negative, recent_rate more negative)
buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric to buy_ce: session must be genuinely negative and recent burst must be accelerating below the threshold multiple

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts ≈ 6 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. A genuine TWAP urgency burst should not retrace 6 spot pts within 30-90s — if it does, the acceleration was noise or a stop-hunt rather than sustained institutional flow. Calibrated to 30s NIFTY moves (2-5 pts option), using the lower end because tight stops are appropriate for high-frequency acceleration entries.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option pts ≈ 10 NIFTY spot pts. Continued TWAP execution over 30-90 seconds typically advances NIFTY 8-15 spot pts further; 5 pts captures the median outcome (~50% of expected move) at 1:1.67 R:R. At the 2-minute horizon, typical NIFTY option moves are 3-7 pts — 5 pts sits at the upper-median, achievable when the acceleration is real.

filters.vix_filter: none — relative momentum acceleration is market-regime agnostic; the session drift rate already normalises for volatility conditions
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:30 IST. Skip first 15 min (09:15-09:30) for opening noise; close at 14:30 to avoid afternoon low-volume drift signals. Warmup: 288 bars (24 min) required to establish meaningful session drift rate.
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY spot volume is noisy at 5s; using price-based relative rate avoids volume contamination
filters.trend_filter: Implicit in session_return sign — only trade CE when session is positive, PE when session is negative
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — as more algo strategies monitor rate-of-rate acceleration, the urgency phase signals may become more crowded; however TWAP institutional flows are structural and unlikely to disappear

adaptation_notes: Original strategy: stocks showing intraday return > 2× NIFTY return signal sustained institutional buying. Adapted by replacing the cross-sectional stock-vs-index comparison with an intraindex time-series comparison: current 2-minute return rate vs session drift rate. The '2x' threshold is preserved directly. The session window is compressed from 10:30-14:30 to 09:30-14:30 (start earlier since we're not scanning multiple stocks — warmup handles the calibration period). Hold time compressed from 30-90 min to 30-90 sec (×60 compression) reflecting that we're catching the burst, not the sustained allocation flow. The 30-min relative return lookback is compressed to 2 min (24 bars) matching the hold time scale. No VIX filter added — original had none and the session drift normalisation already handles volatility context.
weaknesses: Session drift rate is noisy in the first 30-45 min — signals before 10:00 may be unreliable even with warmup filter
If NIFTY gaps up strongly at open, session_rate is inflated all day — 2x threshold may rarely trigger, reducing trade count
Acceleration bursts sometimes coincide with news releases (macro data, RBI commentary) that reverse sharply — no news filter implemented
The session_rate denominator grows all day, making signals harder to trigger in the afternoon when drift is diluted

_source.original_stop: 0.3% from entry OR relative_return flips sign
